_comment: The red/blue text line under the label boxes and the code above the date are ignored on purpose. Regions are fractions of the ORIGINAL slide image: [left, top, right, bottom]. They are deliberately generous because the label shifts a little from slide to slide. 'pattern' validates the normalized value; a value that fails it is kept but marked invalid_format. Edit freely and rerun the lab notebook. VLM endpoints can be overridden with FEATHER_VLM_ENDPOINTS in .env. 'fallback_regions' are wider crops tried in order when the primary and expanded crops give no readable value; 'verify' re-reads a readable value on a second crop and sends disagreements to review. expand_margin is [x, y] added on each side for the 'expanded' crop. 'expand_margin' and 'partial_min_confidence' can also be set per field. A field the model reports as only partly visible is 'partly_visible' (review) when the field has partial: review (bird_id, date: the feather IDs depend on them), else accepted only at confidence >= partial_min_confidence (species and sex, short low-variance text: 0.6; others 0.8).

bird_id.prompt: This crop shows the bird ID: the large black code in the top-center box of a specimen label, formatted like 'A 0012 H' or 'BB 17692 H' (1-2 letters, 4-5 digits, usually a trailing letter). Read it exactly; ignore any smaller text below it.

species.prompt: This crop shows a row with a 5-letter species code in capitals (e.g. HAFLU), possibly followed by an unrelated note such as '3K+' on the right. Return ONLY the 5-letter species code, not the note.

age.prompt: This crop shows the age code in a coloured box at the top-left of a specimen label, like '2K+', '1K' or '3K'. Return only that code.

sex.prompt: This crop shows a single letter for the bird's sex in a grey box at the top-right of a specimen label (usually M or F). Return only that letter.

date.prompt: This crop shows a date in blue text at the bottom-right of a specimen slide, formatted YYYY-MM-DD. Return only that date. Ignore the short black code printed just above it (e.g. '2B', '11C', 'X'): it is not part of the date.

answer_rules: Answer with JSON only: {"value": <text or null>, "visible": "yes" | "partly" | "no", "confidence": <0-1>}. Use visible=no and value=null ONLY if that text is truly absent or fully covered in the crop; never guess characters you cannot see. Use only plain Latin letters, digits and normal punctuation in value; never escape sequences.

handwriting._comment: Check during label reading (label_extract.check_handwriting): one question per region, label strip and date corner. Tested on the 100-slide sample slice100-20261025b: agreed with a hand check on all 100 slides (3 handwritten, 97 not). A hand-check CSV still wins in the tables; the model's answer is kept as handwritten_model.
handwriting.prompt: This is part of a printed specimen label on a scanned feather slide. Is any text in it handwritten (written by hand with a pen or marker, including handwritten corrections, crossed-out printed text, or added notes), rather than printed? Reply with only JSON: {"handwritten": true|false, "fields": [which parts: bird_id, species, age, sex, date, note], "notes": "<at most 15 words: what is handwritten, or ok>"}
